title: The letter from the first harvest

ITEM_HARVEST_LETTER_DESC: "To whoever finds this. From the first harvest."
CP_LETTER_TRIGGER: Sa andsid kirja sellele, kellele see mõeldud oli.
You gave the letter to the one it was meant for.
CP_LETTER_EFFECT: Kiri jõudis kohale. Ta teab nüüd, kus kast on.
The letter arrived. They know where the box is now.

origin: + { not has_item("{ITEM}") and not flag("{FLAG}") } [Kas sa kirjutad? %% Do you write?]
Kirjutasin ühe kirja. Kellele, ei tea. Panin sinna, kus keegi selle kord leiab. # en: I wrote one letter. To whom, I don't know. I put it where somebody will find it one day.
trigger: + { has_item("{ITEM}") and not flag("{FLAG}") } [Anna kiri. %% Give the letter.]
Ta ei loe seda kohe. Ta hoiab seda. # en: They do not read it at once. They hold it.
„Esimesest lõikusest.“ Ma tundsin käekirja ära enne, kui lugesin. # en: "From the first harvest." I knew the hand before I read it.
Kast on kõige vanema puu all. Ma oleksin pidanud arvama. # en: The box is under the oldest tree. I should have guessed.
+ { not has_item("{ITEM}") and not flag("{FLAG}") } [Mida siit otsida oleks? %% What would there be to look for here?]
Ema ütles, et ta kirjutas kõik üles. Ma ei leidnud seda kunagi. # en: Mother said she wrote it all down. I never found it.
